table: SPEC Data Contract section 4 parking-rule table
status: CONFIRMED by the team on 2026-11-03 for the pilot (SR-10). Not Cornell policy. Built from public Cornell pages plus labeled simulator assumptions.

conventions.times: Local wall-clock HH:MM in time_zone. The rule recurs on every date from valid_from to valid_until whose weekday is in days_of_week. end_local_time 24:00 means the end of the day. An end time earlier than the start time means the window runs past midnight into the next date, and belongs to the date it starts on. A start equal to the end is invalid
conventions.wildcard: * in zone or eligibility_class means every value. lot_id is always a single pilot lot, and a rule names a zone only where that lot has spaces in it
conventions.eligibility_class: permit_O and visitor are the declared_eligibility values; accessible means the trip has access_needs true. A valid accessible-parking placard is still required and is not checked by the system. No rule disallows placard holders, because an accessible space is only reached through the accessible class
conventions.closure: A rule with closure true overrides any allowance in the same window
conventions.unresolved: A trip interval not fully covered by an allowing rule is unresolved and must not be shown as eligible (SPEC section 4)
